findings.description: The `renderDebtSheet` JSDoc still says the table is "filtered by text and kind and paged in the browser", but the second commit removed that script; the sheet renders a plain table.
findings.body:
**Stale JSDoc: it describes the filter and pager this PR removed**

The `renderDebtSheet` doc comment says the table is *"filtered by text and kind and paged in the browser"*. Commit 88d70a4 removed that script, and the ADR 0098 amendment defers filtering and paging to task t-mwmjlj6j. At head, `ledgerTable(payDownOrder(ranked))` emits a plain `<table class="moves">`. The debt test asserts that no `data-(row|kind|list|filter|step)` attributes are rendered. This PR adds the clause, which is not on `main`.

The next reader of this seam would think the Debt sheet already has text and kind filters and 25-row pages. They might then hunt for controls that don't exist, or build the follow-up on top of a script that was never kept.

https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/88d70a4f8e3b85a427ad10f07881cef3beccace2/src/core/web-dashboard-debt.service.ts#L110-L116
findings.suggestion:
/**
 * The Debt sheet: how much is open and of what kind and age, the files
 * carrying the most, then one table of every open entry with why it was
 * accepted, until when and by whom. The table opens in pay-down order: the
 * entries of the file `payDownRanking` puts first, oldest first, then the
 * next file's.
 */

findings.description: The 0098 amendment drops everything decision 167 decided (module grouping, treemap, web-dashboard-module-map.service.ts), but docs/adr/0167's Status still says `accepted` with no superseded marker or back-link. scripts/adr-index.sh will list a decision for a deleted feature as current.
